en.name: Anker Nano II 30W Charger
en.description:
## Anker Nano II 30W

A pocket-sized GaN charger that fast-charges phones and laptops alike.

- 30W USB-C Power Delivery output
- 54% smaller than the standard Apple 30W adapter
- Compatible with iPhone, Samsung and most USB-C laptops

## Anker Nano II 30W

Chaajiye GaN ah oo cabbirkeedu yar yahay oo si degdeg ah u chaajiya taleefannada iyo laptops-ka.

- 54% ka yar adapter-ka caadiga ah ee Apple 30W
- La jaanqaadaa iPhone, Samsung iyo inta badan laptops-ka USB-C leh
